sam k: Noticed a small but consistent degradation when we switch to nova-13b-int3 on the golden rerank set (about -0.6% mean). Seems concentrated in long-dialog prompts. Can we triage quick? @li zhang @anya
li zhang: I'll run a minibatch calibration run focused on longctx samples and compare logits distributions vs fp32. ETA ~30m.
anya: Also suspicious of golden-set drift we rolled a small autopruned golden refresh last week. Zoe, did the refresh include longer multi-turns?
zoe: Yep, the refresh pulled ~420 items from the new collector with expanded max_turns=12. I kept the older long-dialog anchors in a holdout shard, but maybe there was overlap.
labelops-bot: relabel job queued by zoe  job_id=9912, samples=200, priority=med.
li zhang: Quick summary from calibration probe: activation scale shift in some attention heads after int3 quant; distribution tails are clipped more aggressively in quantized kernel. I've pulled 60 long-dialog samples with largest KL change.
anya: Could some of those be near-duplicates introduced by the refresh? If so relabeling or removing dup anchors might change metrics.
zoe: I ran a fuzzy-dedupe on the refreshed golden shard at 0.92 sim, found 18 probable near-duplicates vs existing anchors. Moving to a staging prune list.
sam k: Plan: 1) li to run focused kernel tweak (clip relax + per-layer scale) on the 60 samples, 2) zoe to pause automated golden refresh and re-run dedupe at higher threshold for long-dialogs, 3) labelops to prioritize relabel job 9912 for any ambiguous anchors. If tweak removes most KL shifts we can proceed; else ML deep-dive.
li zhang: Starting kernel tweak run now (activation_clip=0.03, per_layer_scale_adjust). Will post diff artifacts.
labelops-bot: relabel job 9912 updated: in progress, assigned to pool "golden-review".
zoe: Paused the refresh pipeline and exported the candidate list to s3://redwood/golden/candidates/1769054321. Dedupe output at s3://redwood/golden/dedupe/1769054321.
sam k: Good. Keep updates here. If tweak doesn't fix, we may need to roll back the golden refresh and run regression tests across 5 eval seeds. :thumbsup:
